note: On the Icefields Parkway (Hwy 93) along the Athabasca River, 34 km south of Jasper townsite. Two loops (sites 1-16 and 17-42) with a kitchen shelter and food lockers. Sandy river bank with a natural canoe launch. --Claude
summary: Keep. 2026 season May 13 - Sep 14 (stored mid-May to mid-Sep was approximate), 42 first-come sites to 27 ft at C$35.75. Parks Canada's name is 'Kerkeslin'. Riverview stands on coarse imagery.
flags: NAME: Parks Canada calls it 'Kerkeslin' / 'Kerkeslin Campground'; stored 'Mount Kerkeslin Campground'. Not changed.
Note: '~36 km south' -> 34 km (page: 'only 34 km from the town of Jasper'). 'Sandy river bank with natural canoe launch' kept from the stored note; not on the pages read.
Facilities: the map shows toilets and water taps without saying vault/flush or potable; stored vault_toilets (derived) left untouched, potable_water left unset.

PIN: no move. Stored 52.63440,-117.86640 falls between the parkway and the river just south of an access track, about 90 m from the river bank (imagery z16, rendered but low resolution: individual loops cannot be made out).
PHONE: entry has none; the Jasper pages give no campground number.

Waterfront: 'riverview' stands, weakly evidenced: Parks Canada says 'Located along the Athabasca River' and its map draws the river beside both loops; imagery is too coarse to show sites or the tree belt. Not downgraded because the agency text and map both place it on the river; no upgrade lead.
Agency rows: the entry inherits the US interagency senior/access discount from the generic `federal` row; it does not apply to Parks Canada.
